notes: οὗ εἵνεκεν → *Because* is taken as one aligned unit under rules 94 and 35, headed on the improper preposition whose ordinary gloss the word is; reading it noncompositional under rule 45, headed on the relative, remains defensible and is the competing analysis.
ἐν ἀφέσει is given its own words rather than absorbed into a single *set at liberty* unit, per rules 2 and 94.

εὐαγγελίσασθαι heads on *tidings* under rule 66, the ASV reserving *proclaim* for κηρύξαι in the same verse; a head on *preach* remains defensible. ἀνάβλεψιν heads on the root word *sight* under rule 104.
